title: AdventHealth advances whole-person care with OpenAI
summary: AdventHealth is using ChatGPT for Healthcare to streamline workflows, reduce administrative burden, and return more time to patient care.
body: AdventHealth is using ChatGPT for Healthcare to streamline workflows, reduce administrative burden, and return more time to patient care.
summaryZh: 医疗机构AdventHealth正在全面部署ChatGPT for Healthcare，旨在简化临床与行政工作流，降低医护人员的行政负担，从而将更多时间回归到患者的整体关怀中。原始信息显示：AdventHealth is using ChatGPT for Healthcare to streamline workflows, reduce administrative burden, and return more time to patient care.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“AdventHealth advances whole-person care with OpenAI”。其重要性主要体现在：AdventHealth正利用OpenAI的医疗大模型优化临床工作流程并减少行政负担。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
